fields.name: database_url
fields.label: Database address
fields.help: Postgres connection string. Set this or the database address file, not both.

fields.name: database_url_file
fields.label: Database address file
fields.reason: It makes the monitor read a file inside the hub's container.

fields.name: ava_username
fields.label: AVA username
fields.help: The student's CPF. Dots, dashes and spaces are ignored.

fields.name: ava_password
fields.label: AVA password
fields.help: Set this or the AVA password file, not both. Saving restarts the monitor, and that is one login to the portal.

fields.name: ava_password_file
fields.label: AVA password file
fields.reason: It makes the monitor read a file inside the hub's container.

fields.name: courses
fields.label: Courses
fields.help: Names of the courses to watch. Case and accents are ignored when matching.

fields.name: check_interval
fields.label: Check interval
fields.help: How often to read the portal. At least 15m.

fields.name: payment_reminder_days
fields.label: Payment reminder days
fields.help: Days before the due date to remind about a payment, each from 0 to 60.

fields.name: payment_overdue_repeat
fields.label: Overdue payment repeat
fields.help: How often to repeat the reminder of an overdue payment. 0 turns the repetition off.

fields.name: boleto_link
fields.label: Link to the boleto
fields.help: Include the payment slip link in payment notifications.

fields.name: billing_day_net
fields.label: Billing day net
fields.help: Days before the monthly due day to warn when the portal still shows no invoice. auto learns the number from past invoices (3 until it has learned), a whole number from 1 to 28 sets it, and off turns the warning off.

fields.name: deadline_reminder_days
fields.label: Deadline reminder days
fields.help: Days before an activity deadline to remind about it, each from 0 to 60.

fields.name: calendar_categories
fields.label: Calendar categories
fields.help: Which kinds of calendar events to report.

fields.name: reminder_hour
fields.label: Reminder hour
fields.help: Hour of the day, 0 to 23, in the AVA time zone, from which reminders are sent.

fields.name: failing_alert_after
fields.label: Failing alert after
fields.help: How long the portal must keep failing before an alert is sent. At least 1h.
